C1.justification: Runtime scaling shows power-law exponent ~1.035 and consistent t/(N log N) ratios with low CV, matching O(N log N).

C2.justification: Convergence rates are directionally consistent but below first-order accuracy (~0.73). Plane-wave test reproduces exact solution.

C3.justification: No monotone violations observed in variable-speed test; propagation is consistent with upwind monotonicity.

judge.one_line: Runtime scaling and monotonicity replicated; convergence directionally consistent but suboptimal.
